item.text: The backend currently always sends provisioned throughput when it creates a table, and initialization has no billing mode check before enabling auto scaling. I’ll make the creation request depend on the configured mode and use the table’s reported mode for existing tables.

item.text: The AWS SDK uses uppercase billing mode values, while the requested config values are lowercase. I’ve mapped the config values to the SDK constants and kept the default as `pay_per_request`. I’m adding focused tests for the create request and the table status result.

item.text:
Implemented DynamoDB `billing_mode` support. It accepts `pay_per_request` and `provisioned`, defaults to `pay_per_request`, and sends the corresponding AWS billing mode and throughput settings when creating a table. Initialization now uses an existing table’s reported billing mode to disable auto scaling when the table is on-demand, with a log message; it does the same before creating an on-demand table.

Updated the [backend documentation](/app/docs/pages/reference/backends.mdx) and added focused tests. `go test ./lib/backend/dynamo -count=1` and `git diff --check` pass.
